docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Mookerji’s Gaekwad lectures on Aśoka: his life and times, his dhamma and his edicts, with the text of the inscriptions in Sanskrit and English (London, 1928). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the UCLA Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Asoka <Gaekwad lectures> · Radhakumud Mookerji, Mookerji, Radhakumud, 1884-1964 · 1928, 334 scanned pages. Published 1928; Radhakumud Mookerji died 1964; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
